## Scenario 61 – *"Life and Death"* → Conclusion: Section **67.1**

### Summary of the Conclusion
After surviving the cave full of Deep Terrors, the party emerges to find a group of cloaked figures gathered around a fire. Two elderly Orchids — **Moonshard** and **Terra** — reveal they have been awaiting the party for two hundred years. Terra explains they are preparing to stop the **Harbinger**, an ancient being bound deep within the earth whose dreams corrupt the world and weaken the seals containing it. A unique crystalline Savvas called the **Shattersong** is also introduced as part of their preparations. Crain connects this to his research on star iron.

## Scenario 61 – *Life and Death* — Conclusion (Section 67.1)

The conclusion section is **67.1**, read at the end of the round when all enemies are dead.

### Narrative Summary
Your party escapes the cave with Moonshard, emerging into the night air. Outside, you encounter a group of cloaked figures gathered around a fire, led by an ancient Orchid named **Terra**. She reveals she has foreseen this meeting for 200 years and introduces the **Shattersong** — a uniquely evolved lineage of Savvas, tuned to the thoughts of a great evil called the **Harbinger**. Terra explains that you and Crain have a crucial role in stopping the Harbinger before it breaks through the seals containing it.

---

### Rewards
- **Unlock class box** (a new character class is unlocked).

---

### What It Unlocks / Points to Next

| Type | Reference | Details |
|---|---|---|
| 📅 Calendar Section | **140.3** | Add section 140.3 to the calendar in **one week**. |

So the conclusion **does not immediately unlock a new scenario**, but it schedules **section 140.3** to appear on the campaign calendar in one week's time — which will likely trigger the next story development when that date arrives.
